    Live across Miami‑Dade, Broward and Palm Beach. NMLS 1788120.

    Elbaz Construction is not a lender and does not approve, decline or fund applications. Every rate, term and approval decision comes from the financing partner. PACE covers specific improvements; a kitchen remodel is generally not one of them.

    Consumer credit

    Synchrony
    Project Card, revolving. 6–132 months of special financing as published. One card, reusable across projects.
    Service Finance
    Fixed installment loan. First payment 30 days after completion. No pre-payment penalty.

    The usual route for kitchens and bathrooms.

    Property-assessed (PACE)

    Ygrene
    Not a loan: repaid with property taxes. Up to a 20-year published residential term. Soft credit pull.
    Renew Financial
    RenewPACE. Up to $250K published, and up to 20% of property value. No application fee.

    For qualifying improvements such as roofing, impact windows and storm protection.
